policy: Semantic mapping: every source label/utterance was judged by its actual meaning; no blind word matching.
UNKNOWN = in-domain command that cannot be confidently assigned to a canonical class (directional brightness/temperature, mute, bare control words, non-canonical slot values).
EXCLUDE = out of the project's command domain (change language, bring items, email, taxi, QA, greetings, calendar events, shopping lists, ...).

Slot values are extracted from the dataset's own entity annotations (SLURP time/color_type spans) and verified against the sentence text; directional commands without a value are UNKNOWN, never forced to the nearest value.
Speaker IDs preserved as metadata only (never a class).

fluent_speech_commands.method: all 248 unique transcripts reviewed; mapping keyed on the dataset's (action, object) slots with explicit phrase overrides

increase|heat / decrease|heat / *|temper: directional heating command, no canonical level value (18/22/26 degrees)
increase|volume: incl. 'Turn the sound up', 'Volume max', 'Far too quiet'
activate|music: incl. Play / Resume / Put on the music
change language|*: device language setting: not in ontology

slurp.method: intent-keyed (intent is the dataset's semantic annotation); slot values extracted from entity spans (time, color_type) and cross-checked against sentence text; sentence-level cues used for ambiguous intents

weather_query: incl. indirect questions ('do i need an umbrella today'); non-weather sentences excluded
datetime_query: only when the sentence asks for the time (time/clock/hour/am/pm words, no date words); date queries excluded
iot_hue_lighton / hue_lighton: light words or darkness cue ('it's too dark here')
iot_hue_lightoff / hue_lightoff: light words or sleep cue ('time to sleep')
iot_hue_lightdim / hue_lightdim / iot_hu: directional brightness command without a canonical level value
iot_hue_lightchange: exact color entity; other colors (yellow, orange, white, ...) excluded
iot_wemo_on / wemo_on: only when the sentence targets a light; plug/socket on excluded (no generic-plug class)
iot_wemo_off / wemo_off: only when the sentence targets a light; plug/socket off excluded
music_settings: skip/next -> NEXT; stop -> STOP; repeat/shuffle/equalizer excluded
alarm_set: time entity in {six am, eight am, nine pm}; other times -> UNKNOWN
calendar_set with 'remind': reminder command with non-canonical reminder value
calendar_set (events): calendar event scheduling is not a reminder
all other intents: not in ontology (email, transport, news, QA, social, cooking, ...)

google_speech_commands_v2.method: single-word labels (no transcripts); only words whose meaning is unambiguous in the ontology are mapped

on / off / up / down: bare control words: in-domain but the target is ambiguous (lights? music? volume?) - not confidently a canonical class
left / right / forward / backward / foll: directional/action words: no matching canonical class
yes / no: confirmation words: not commands in this ontology
